name: Peki – Fiken Integration for WooCommerce
author: PEKI LTD

sections.description:
Peki – Fiken Integration for WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store with the Norwegian accounting system Fiken.

When orders are completed in WooCommerce, this connector can export the relevant data to create vouchers in Fiken. It’s designed to reduce manual bookkeeping and minimize errors.

Independent plugin. This is a third-party connector by Peki. We are not affiliated with Fiken AS or WooCommerce/Automattic.

Why choose this plugin?

  • Automatic accounting: Completed WooCommerce orders can be sent to Fiken.
  • Simple setup: Connect your store to Fiken in a few steps.
  • Save time and reduce errors: No more manual entry.
  • Subscriptions support: Subscription orders are handled too.
  • Built to WordPress coding standards: Stability and security focused.

Key Features

  • Connect WooCommerce to Fiken
  • Automatically send completed orders to Fiken
  • Manual “Send to Fiken” from order actions
  • Refund handling: create credit notes in Fiken
  • GDPR-aware: only sends data needed for the export
  • Translation-ready (peki-fiken-integration-for-woocommerce)

External services

This plugin connects to Peki’s export service and the Fiken API to perform processing outside your WordPress site.

  • Peki export service (peki.no)
    Used to securely process and transform WooCommerce order data, and forward it to Fiken’s API.
    When data is sent: When you connect, disconnect, or trigger an export (manually or automatically on order status).
    What data is sent:
    – Site URL and technical identifiers for troubleshooting
    – Order data required to create vouchers (order ID, totals, currency, taxes, line items/product, quantity, unit price, tax)
    – Customer details necessary for vouchers (e.g., name and email), when required by Fiken
    – Integration identifiers returned during the connect flow (e.g., company slug / tokens)
    Provider: Peki AS (peki.no) — Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are available on peki.no.

  • Fiken (fiken.no)
    Accounting platform and API used to create vouchers.
    When data is sent: When the export service calls Fiken’s API on your behalf.
    What data is sent: Voucher information derived from your WooCommerce orders and your integration identifiers.
    Provider: Fiken (fiken.no) — Please review Fiken’s Terms and Privacy Policy on fiken.no.

By using this plugin you accept that processing happens on external servers (peki.no and fiken.no).

Privacy

  • The plugin transmits only the data required to complete the export you initiate.
  • No analytics/telemetry is collected by the plugin.
  • Review the external services’ Terms and Privacy for details about their processing and retention.

Disclaimer: This is an independent connector by Peki. Not affiliated with Fiken AS or WooCommerce/Automattic.

Who is this plugin for?

  • Norwegian WooCommerce stores using Fiken for accounting
  • Small and medium-sized online businesses
  • Merchants who want to automate bookkeeping

Translations

This plugin is fully translatable. All user-facing strings use the text domain peki-fiken-integration-for-woocommerce.
To contribute translations, create a .po/.mo for your locale and place it under /languages/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/peki-fiken-integration-for-woocommerce or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Peki → Fiken in the admin menu and follow the steps to connect your WooCommerce store to Fiken.
  4. Completed orders can now be transferred to your Fiken account.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Fiken account?

Yes. You need an active Fiken account with the API module (“Ekstern tjeneste”) enabled in Fiken.

Does the plugin work for companies that are not VAT registered?

No. The plugin currently targets companies registered for VAT.

Does it support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes. Orders with subscriptions are handled as well.

Is my data safe?

Yes. The plugin sends data over secure connections and does not store sensitive financial data locally. See the “External services” section for details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Compliance: Removed remaining upgrade/plan wording from admin and docs; neutral “Manage Subscription” link only.
  • Security: Nonce + capability checks reviewed for connect/disconnect flows.
  • Prefix: Migrated internal filters/options to a unique pekifiken_ prefix with legacy fallbacks.
  • API: Limit/plan decisions fully delegated to the remote service; plugin only surfaces remote errors neutrally.
  • Docs: Expanded “External services” section.

1.0.2

  • Compliance/doc updates and refund handling improvements.

1.0.1

  • Fix: Dismissible notice behavior; clarified docs.

1.0.0

  • First public release.
